messages:
mira: Quick heads-up 1 I'm putting together a tiny naming glossary + prose-vs-code note to reduce copy/paste breakages. Found mixed uses: 'model_variant' vs 'model variant', 'route' vs 'endpoint', and 'canary deploy' vs 'canary rollout'.
alex: Good call. For prose prefer space-separated terms; in code use the exact SDK param. Add mapping examples.
dan: I'll draft the code examples (JS camelCase, Python snake_case) and add a snippet lint hook so CI flags broken examples.
kevin: I'll run a link pass for migration-guide and fix stale /deploy paths to /guides/deployments. Leave redirect notes.
mira: Plan: mira -> glossary PR draft; dan -> code-note + examples; kevin -> link sweep. Draft branch: docs/naming-sprint/mira.
docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 (docs/naming-sprint/mira) 1 auto-tagged 'docs' and 'needs-review'.
alex: Add changelog guidance: any change that could break copy/paste should get a changelog entry.
mira: Will include a 3-row deprecation mapping and short checklist. Target merge by Friday.
dan: I'll add tests for snippets in the PR to keep it safe.
kevin: If anyone sees ambiguous Console labels, drop screenshots in the PR so Product can triage.
mira: Thanks all, will update the draft and request reviews. :rocket:
